verdict.rationale: Skyvern offers a REST API and SDKs (skyvern-docs-1, skyvern-docs-17), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer, a try-it console, or runnable reference examples. The probe for a published OpenAPI spec also returned 404 on all candidate paths. API availability alone is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward an interactive, runnable reference.
